entities.summary: The National Concert Hall is a national cultural institution, sometimes described as "the home of music in Ireland". It comprises the actual concert hall operation, which in various chambers hosts over 1,000 events each year, as well as a full orchestra, National Symphony Orchestra Ireland, and three choirs: National Symphony Chorus Ireland, NCH Cór na nÓg and NCH Cór Linn.
